_about: Module definitions for the processing group (A4, A5). See logistics.json for the shape. `front` is where a Macerator's mouth and a Press's or Caster's block are. The Sieve and Centrifuge share the separator kind, with `pass` as a list of rules (one per out face; `kinds`, `heavy`, `light`, `power` a cell). The Electrolyser splits Brine and Water in its own kind (rate cells a scan, power a cell). The Boiler, Chiller and Furnace share the thermal kind: params target (degrees), rate (degrees a scan), power (a second while it works), cap; `pass` with `kinds` or `mats` lets only those out of its face; `melts` is the temperature its casing stands.

modules.name: Macerator
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Grinds the loose rigid bodies (a collapsed slab, a Press's block) that touch its open top into powder, a few cells at a time: Stone becomes Rubble. The powder goes out of its side face into a Tank or Funnel joined there. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and power per cell.

modules.name: Press
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Powder joined into its bottom face is squeezed, once there is enough of one kind, into a solid block (a rigid body) that comes out of its side: Rubble becomes Stone, Loose dirt becomes Dirt. Each block takes 3 seconds and some power, and needs open air in front for the block.

modules.name: Boiler
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Heats what a Tank passes into its bottom face to 130 degrees, so Water boils to Steam, and lets only the gas out of its top face into whatever is joined there. What the boiling leaves behind (Salt from Brine, Pitch from Slick) goes out of its left face. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and power while it heats.

modules.name: Chiller
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Cools what a Tank passes into its bottom face to 20 below zero, so Water freezes to Ice and Brine turns to Chillant, and lets only Ice and Chillant out of its top face. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and power while it cools.

modules.name: Furnace
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Heats what a Tank passes into its bottom face to 950 degrees: Sand fuses to Glass, and Ferrite or Veinstone with Flux smelts to Slag and Ferrite bars or Wire. Glass, bars, Wire and Slag go out of its top face; everything else stays in to cook. Its casing stands 1500 degrees. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and power while it heats.

modules.name: Caster
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Liquid joined into its bottom face is set, once there is enough of one kind, into a solid block (a rigid body) that comes out of its side: Lava becomes Obsidian, Slag a crust, Quickmire Mire stone, Water Ice. Each block takes 4 seconds and some power, and needs open air in front for the block.

modules.name: Electrolyser
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. Splits what a Tank passes into its bottom face, for power a cell from a Node or the Hub in reach: two cells of Brine become two Lye, a Chlor and a Lift, and a cell of Water becomes a Lift (the oxygen vents). Lift goes out of its top face, Lye out of the left and Chlor out of the right; Brine and Water stay in until they are split.

modules.name: Sieve
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. A Tank passes a mix into its bottom face; liquids and gases go out of its top face and solids (powder and rock) out of its left face, each into whatever is joined there. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and a little power a cell.

modules.name: Centrifuge
modules.blurb: Bolted in place. A Tank passes a mix into its bottom face; it spins the mix apart by density, the lightest material out of its top face and the densest out of its left face, one material at a time. Needs a Node or the Hub in reach, and power a cell.
